run_rcnn_supervised_forward: run the TwoStagePseudoLabGeneralizedRCNN forward pass in supervised branch mode for training with ground truth instances
run_rcnn_unsupervised_forward: run the TwoStagePseudoLabGeneralizedRCNN forward pass in unsup_data_weak branch mode for pseudo-label generation without targets
run_rcnn_val_loss_forward: run the TwoStagePseudoLabGeneralizedRCNN forward pass in val_loss branch mode to compute validation losses with ground truth
review_rcnn_inference: review the TwoStagePseudoLabGeneralizedRCNN inference method for running model predictions during evaluation or deployment
test_rcnn_forward_branches: test the TwoStagePseudoLabGeneralizedRCNN forward method across supervised, unsup_data_weak, and val_loss branches
